application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description: Rear Garden: T1 - Lime Reduce crown to points of previous reduction whilst retaining furnishing growth, Approx 2m branch length removal.Prune clear of building by 2m. Thin crown by removal of 30% of internal epicormic growth (Retain some lower growth on trunk). Trees approx. height 12m.Reason for work: This tree is situated in close proximity to Malferna House and this pruning is proposed to keep the tree managed to allow some light into the building and garden below whilst maintaining some screening between the adjacent properties
decision_conditions: <p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">CONDITION: This permission shall expire after a period of two years from the date of this decision.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; vertical-align: baseline;"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON:&nbsp; In order that the Local Planning Authority can review any change in circumstances after this period and to avoid the accumulation of unimplemented permissions.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">CONDITION: The tree works hereby approved shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the description on this notice of approval by a suitable qualified tree surgeon and in accordance with BS3998:2010 ‘Recommendations for tree works’ (or any standard that reproduces or replaces this standard).&nbsp;</span></p><p><br></p><p dir="ltr" style="text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON:&nbsp; In the interests of visual amenity and good arboricultural practice, having regard to Policy LP51 in the Local Plan 2033 (adopted 2020).</span></p>
